[registry](control-registry.json) owns these mappings; [engineering](engineering.md)

## Mechanisms and coverage

### C-PORTABLE — Portable regression lane (automatic)

Portable source, adapter, SDK, record/persistence and viewer regressions using synthetic/real-component fixtures. Native engine behavior and actual player outcomes are separate lanes. The existing tools/check.py runner executes syntax, selected Ruff, Import Linter, document metadata/local links, governance/protocol agreement and whitespace. Local --fast stops there with calendar-only warnings. Strict full/editorial/movement/viewer/main-smoke profiles also render diagrams and enforce current-date governance. Full collects existing unittest cases through pinned pytest with four pytest-xdist processes, built-in work stealing and 20 slowest durations; component profiles run explicit consumer/boundary tests grouped by file; main-smoke runs fixed selected cases serially. Every behavioral profile runs the Node viewer suite; editorial omits behavioral/viewer tests. tools/ci.py owns the shared explicit scope/test manifest and chooses from complete native Git diffs and existing GitHub PR/run/job facts under docs/project-management.md#protected-ci-profiles; unknown/nonregular eligibility selects full. docs/testing.md maps responsibilities, useful overlap and duplication review. Worker/check failures propagate without restart, ignored failures or cached green results. Focused development tests remain selected by the lead. Portable fixtures do not qualify gameplay or browser layout. Native pytest strict marker registration rejects undeclared metadata; the representative assurance groups in docs/testing.md support navigation/focused development, not production profile routing or semantic-coverage claims.

Owner: maintainer. Trigger: Fast structural checks on each configured local commit; focused tests on affected behavior; appropriate strict profile at coherent integration/formal acceptance and main-targeting PR/main CI events; broad source changes require full regression before merge.
Enforcement: Opt-in project-local pre-commit hook runs --fast. The always-present Actions controller selects a strict profile for PRs explicitly targeting main and pushes to main; no workflow path filters or ignored failures. Logs/Actions summary state profile/reason and qualifying PR coverage for main-smoke. Covered documentation and explicit movement/viewer boundaries receive their declared strict scopes; cross-cutting, validation and unknown PR changes receive full. Changed validation machinery/context also forces full on main. GitHub concurrency cancels superseded PR runs only. Main retains strict Actions-app15368 controller requirement under ruleset25346774. Hooks remain bypassable. Hosted activation evidence must be recorded in the issue/PR after actual execution; this definition is not a hosted pass.
Failure response: Preserve failure output, fix the cause and rerun before claiming portable acceptance.

### C-RUNTIME — Live authority and input guards (runtime)

Single-controller mission dispatch and admission, original typed operation accounting, HTTP trust boundary, historical memory observer and spectator input freshness. One current typed mission contract and one authenticated writer use exact controller leases, immutable sources, original root/child/mission limits and durable intent/result accounting. Captured samples retain their as-of identity and original clocks across healthy newer views under unchanged custody; semantic applicability is separately proved. Ordinary healthy non-equivalence refuses input and requires a distinct decision/Observe lineage; future clocks, revision contradictions and immutable-source changes remain faults. Native independently checks receiver, session, revision, boundary, custody, Pause/takeover, pending control and original clocks/deadline. Retained native-issued captures preserve their original timestamp and complete normalized observation metadata; non-image-conditioned input may survive incidental rendering churn without retargeting or renewing freshness. Clicks and image-conditioned input retain applicable exact-image/geometry checks. Registered normal Save start and provisional identity readmission use native-state equivalence; setup, confirmation, actual identity-screen and recovery retain their stronger policies. Owned creation/save/load, committed transition/effect proof, first-normal identity, separate charged readmission and canonical identity adoption remain mandatory. Unknown delivery is never replayed or rewritten: bounded diagnostic collection and explicit effect reconciliation retain original receipts, costs and uncertainty. Ordinary known-unpublished capture refusal preserves only qualified read-only custody until explicit Observe and new intent; fatal ownership, processing/storage, global budget and historical-integrity faults still stop. Original navigation/activity/menu/editor/item scopes, quantities and deadlines survive continuation, with no automatic prompt confirmation or new allowance. Quiescent handoff/claim retains actor history and unfinished Work; history, memory, advice and packets grant no input authority. Normal Finish requires exact owned exits and coherent objective Work, writes an immutable report and sends no native input. The spectator distinguishes live custody and unresolved effects from historical frames, memory, results and process samples. The protocol owns detailed predicates and supported limits; portable tests and dated native reports provide separate evidence. The generic host settles its own coherent completed handoff before further dispatch/inference. MCP retains the assigned collection identity through unfinished/uncertain responses; the driver independently validates live succession. Neither mechanism reconstructs authority.

Owner: controller and viewer maintainer. Trigger: every relevant request, observation and image decode.
Enforcement: Implemented at runtime; regression execution is C-PORTABLE. Source references alone establish no behavioral pass.
Failure response: Reject or freeze further dispatch; expose error and reconcile by observation before explicit resume.

Overview, navigation, control ownership, freshness, recovery limits and next decision. Whole player-configuration responsiveness and visible useful progress. At changed guidance/UI or milestone review, walk the intended reader/player task from its entry point to the current rule, owner, consequence and evidence. Check whether explanation, exact contract, procedure and history are distinguishable and whether the answer can be reviewed without loading an unrelated corpus; use S-DOCS for decomposition. Inspect affected visuals/flows at ordinary window width. For apparent responsiveness use S-UX and the prospective useful-progress/quality/stall criteria for the whole configuration; inspect real gameplay rather than proxy counts. Development continuation and qualification remain distinct under project-management policy.

Owner: lead with operator feedback. Trigger: user-facing behavior/guidance change and milestone review.
Enforcement: Required review under S-UX/S-DOCS/S-WORK; no automatic usability gate.
Failure response: Correct misleading flows or guidance and retain consequential limits before milestone acceptance.

### C-BOUNDARY — Architectural dependency contracts (automatic)

Declared controller and server dependency boundaries, including indirect imports through harness modules. All passive gameplay modules, including supervision, must not import controller, HTTP, CLI or process/build tooling. Shared movement policy cannot depend on consumers, clock, filesystem or transport. Import Linter uses the pyproject.toml forbidden contracts: controller cannot depend on server, CLI, declared network modules or build tooling; server cannot depend on CLI/tools; CLI may compose both. Fourth forbidden contract isolates harness.movement; negative import fixtures exercise it.

Owner: harness maintainer. Trigger: common command; architecture changes require rule review.
Enforcement: Common command runs the real lint-imports executable and propagates failure; temporary source fixtures exercise allowed composition and direct/indirect forbidden imports.
Failure response: Remove reversed dependency or review the boundary and checker together before accepting changed architecture.

### C-REVIEW — Design and independent change review (manual)

Consequential designs, implementation, tests, delegation and exceptions. At Ready, material rescope or integration, use the existing Issue/PR to review the required outcome, fit, affected responsibility and constraints under S-ARCH/S-WORK and risk-based assurance. Revisit applicable earlier violations: trace each to its current mechanism, a representative executable assertion or real-game evidence gap, and an owned disposition. Review actual producer/consumer paths and realistic failure shapes; record uncertainty and defer only with owner, trigger and acceptance. Apply the existing independent-review/publication rules, inspect staged changes and public identity, and reconcile current guidance/Issues. This is one proportionate boundary/outcome review, not another per-action approval stage.

Owner: lead; reviewer supplies independent findings. Trigger: Ready selection, material scope/forecast change, significant change, new boundary/guarantee/dependency or integration checkpoint.
Enforcement: Required by S-AGENT and the GitHub work/PR workflow; independent agent review is manually recorded, not an independent GitHub human approval. Hosted enforcement is recorded separately in acceptance.
Failure response: Reshape or split an unfit core before commitment; resolve material findings or record scoped owner/reason/revisit exception without waiving user constraints or required evidence; after two unsuccessful worker repairs lead takes back the work.

### C-SETUP — Isolated pinned setup (runtime)

Owner: build maintainer. Trigger: each requested setup stage and dependency/compiler change.
Enforcement: Implemented stage guards plus portable setup regressions; native reproducibility requires C-NATIVE and manual provenance review.
Failure response: Stop failed stage, preserve diagnostics and retry only after identifying the corrupt input or owned workspace.

### C-RELEASE — Exact candidate and evidence review (manual)

Development checkpoint provenance and formal acceptance/release source identity and validation lanes. Inspect staged diff and public identity before each checkpoint; fast structural and applicable focused tests support a frozen finite development run. Before formal acceptance/merge, resolve independent review, verify appropriate exact PR/main CI under docs/project-management.md#protected-ci-profiles, full regression before merge for broad source changes, pins/exceptions and relevant native/graphical outcomes. A complete unchanged development run may supply prospective functional evidence after qualification, without becoming held-out data. Git owns source identity: commit before each native run, use commit/tree/diff/PR and hash external artifacts rather than building source history.

Owner: lead or releasing maintainer. Trigger: Development source checkpoint; comprehensive qualification at integrated acceptance, merge, release or new support claim.
Enforcement: Main requires a PR, the Actions-bound controller check and resolved conversations; no force-push/deletion or configured bypass. Lead still owns native/release acceptance. Zero required human approvals is an explicit single-account limit; agent review is not human approval.
Failure response: Block affected development on applicable authority/identity/Pause/budget/delivery/migration/cleanup failures. Hold formal acceptance/release until required failed or unexecuted lanes are resolved; preserve original outcomes and limits. Pending unrelated full CI is not an automatic development gate.

Evidence / implementation: [docs/setup.md#evidence-and-releases](../docs/setup.md#evidence-and-releases), [docs/engineering.md](../docs/engineering.md), [docs/runbook.md#native-acceptance-lane](../docs/runbook.md#native-acceptance-lane), [native/upstream.json](../native/upstream.json), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-workflow.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-workflow.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-waypoint-readiness.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-waypoint-readiness.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-enactive-migration.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-enactive-migration.md), [docs/changes/054-development-first-delivery.md](../docs/changes/054-development-first-delivery.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-23-discovery-learning-ninth-attempt.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-23-discovery-learning-ninth-attempt.md), [docs/changes/062-player-decision-context.md](../docs/changes/062-player-decision-context.md).

Coverage gap: Working-tree hooks do not prove a partially staged candidate. Hosted source/check enforcement does not establish native gameplay, semantic review or release authority. No tag or release automation is installed; administrators can later change rules. GitHub requires association with an opened PR, not use of its merge button; a passing PR head can be pushed and recognized as merged. A required-PR rejection probe needs a CI-passing commit with no PR.

### C-MAINTENANCE — Drift, recovery and retention review (manual)

Active guidance, dependency/research freshness, failure evidence and project-owned cleanup. At behavior/control failure, release, resumption or the recorded due date, reassess the affected current guidance, mechanism, evidence and cost under S-CODE/S-OPS/S-DOCS/S-EVIDENCE. Use the existing Issue and registry record to keep, strengthen, simplify, replace or retire the control; preserve historical failures and unknown labor. Promote a demonstrated recurrence into an appropriate boundary regression or real-game assessment. Compare useful gameplay reached with available setup/check/review/rework burden, and separate API estimates/invoices/unknown usage from conservative reservations. Revisit duplicate private tooling and documentary inventories; use maintained entry points and authoritative evidence families. C-GOVERNANCE detects structural/due-date faults when invoked; review quality and semantic detection remain manual.

Owner: maintainer; lead tracks active work. Trigger: behavior/control failure, release, resumed work or active-development review interval.
Enforcement: Manual event-triggered review under S-OPS/S-AGENT/S-DOCS/S-EVIDENCE; C-GOVERNANCE checks registry structure and dates. Fast warnings do not postpone applicable incident/resumption/change/release review or permit work across actual failures/evidence gaps. Resolve overdue review at the existing integration/formal-acceptance checkpoint; every strict CI profile enforces current-date governance.
Failure response: Record the owner and action in the existing Issue, repair guidance and preserve failures. Retire saves only through owned archive/hash verification and applicable authorization in the runbook; cleanup is not normal game completion.

Evidence / implementation: [docs/work.md](../docs/work.md), [docs/runbook.md](../docs/runbook.md), [docs/research-engineering.md](../docs/research-engineering.md), [docs/research.md](../docs/research.md), [docs/environment.md](../docs/environment.md), [docs/changes/052-distraction-confirmation.md](../docs/changes/052-distraction-confirmation.md), [docs/changes/053-operation-entry-refresh.md](../docs/changes/053-operation-entry-refresh.md), [docs/changes/054-development-first-delivery.md](../docs/changes/054-development-first-delivery.md), [docs/changes/062-player-decision-context.md](../docs/changes/062-player-decision-context.md), [docs/testing.md](../docs/testing.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-27-gameplay-workflow-audit.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-27-gameplay-workflow-audit.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-24-audit-remediation.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-24-audit-remediation.md).

### C-VISUAL — Rendered visual documentation (automatic)

Mermaid sources and generated SVGs in docs/diagrams. Pinned local Mermaid CLI renders every source in a headless project-local browser. Hash receipt covers sources, config, wrapper, package lock and tracked SVGs; title/description and root SVG ID are required. Explicit --write regenerates; normal checks leave tracked files unchanged.

Owner: documentation maintainer. Trigger: common command; source, renderer configuration or dependency changes require rendered review.
Enforcement: Common command fails on renderer errors, missing title/description/ID or changed input/output receipts; negative fixtures include a real parse failure. No global installation or automatic fetch.
Failure response: Fix syntax or missing setup; regenerate stale output and inspect the rendered result. Never call a denied browser launch a passed check. Resolve semantic/readability findings through C-USABILITY/C-REVIEW.

Evidence / implementation: [tools/diagrams.py](../tools/diagrams.py), [tests/test_diagrams.py](../tests/test_diagrams.py), [docs/diagrams/rendered.json](../docs/diagrams/rendered.json), [docs/architecture.md](../docs/architecture.md), [docs/overview.md](../docs/overview.md), [package.json](../package.json), [package-lock.json](../package-lock.json), [.puppeteerrc.cjs](../.puppeteerrc.cjs), [docs/decisions/004-documentation-controls.md](../docs/decisions/004-documentation-controls.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-workflow.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-workflow.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-recovery-evaluation.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-public-recovery-evaluation.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-passive-supervisor.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-17-passive-supervisor.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-integrated-player.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-integrated-player.md), [docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-walk-reassessment.md](../docs/acceptance/2026-10-18-walk-reassessment.md).

## Interpreting results

Run `.venv/bin/python tools/check.py` for the portable lane; update this map with
`.venv/bin/python tools/governance.py --write`. The latter validates before writing and
does not run gameplay. Dated executions belong in [acceptance](acceptance/2026-10-17-mvp.md)
and [work](work.md), with exact candidate, failures and unexecuted lanes.
